title: 2026可隆宁海越野挑战赛 邓国敏获男子百公里组第四
claims: Gu Rongchao won the 100 km men's race in 9:25:07 and Veronika Leng won the women's race in 11:09:11.
Deng Guomin finished fourth in 9:58:09 and broke ten hours on the course.
The 2026 event had about 6,000 runners from 29 countries and regions across the three races.

claimVerification.note: 新浪体育赛报写明顾荣朝 9:25:07、Veronika Leng 11:09:11。
同一段写明邓国敏 9:58:09、第四名、跑进 10 小时。
